title: 9/03 idle: the reach-57 policy table was all-skip once 57 became unreachable, so production stopped picking
tier_reason: no production pick would have been made for the rest of the season (delivery impact) although the season best could still be beaten

contract.text: Production keeps picking while the account's season best can still be beaten; it may stop only when the best streak can no longer be improved (owner requirement).
contract.source: docs/audit/2026-09-03-emax-tail-policy.md §Incident (owner requirement quoted verbatim); CLAUDE.md 'Tail policy (2026-09-03)'

mechanism.text: solve_mdp maximises P(reach 57) and values every action at exactly 0 when streak + 2*days_left < 57; np.argmax falls to index 0 = skip, so the shipped table was all-skip for days_left <= 28 and every cycle logged SKIP

verified_recovered.how: first tail-regime Policy: journal line at 15:24 ET; that day's pick delivered at 18:18 ET; P-05 audit: regime, trust, provenance and stop rule correct on all 25 dates 9/03-9/27 (0 violations / 191 checks)

residual.text: The tail policy uses one late-season quality bin (a variance-reduction trade chosen by the owner); an exact two-bin solve disagrees on 12% of tail cells.
The shipped reach-57 policy's own profiles are lost, so the base policy cannot be re-solved, only extended; the tail artifact is sha-bound to it and must be rebuilt after any base rebuild.

watchdog.trigger: the decision policy returns skip on a date where the stop rule (min(57, s + 2d) <= trusted best) does not hold, or every cycle of a games day ends in skip with a trusted best still beatable
watchdog.recovery_assertion: decision.json records the expected objective (reach57 iff s + 2d >= 57, else emax_season_best), a trusted best, the paired tail sha and no degraded_reason, and a pick is delivered unless the stop rule holds
